defs.def: a daughter of your son or daughter （外）孙女

ex.s: Though friendly, he could easily knock over my niece’s small boys and my six-month-old granddaughter.
ex.t: 虽然他很友善，但他很容易撞倒我侄女的小男孩和我六个月大的孙女。

ex.s: Their stay in Elkhead is the subject of Nothing Daunted: The Unexpected Education of Two Society Girls in the West by Dorothy Wickenden, who is a magazine editor and Dorothy Woodruff’s granddaughter.
ex.t: 她们在埃尔克黑德的经历是多萝西·威肯登所著《毫不畏惧：两位上流社会女孩在西部的意外教育》一书的主题，威肯登是一位杂志编辑，也是多萝西·伍德拉夫的外孙女。

ex.s: Granddaughter Gayle Parks，31-who works alongside her in the family business-said it remained unknown as to who nominated Irene for the award.
ex.t: 31岁的孙女盖尔·帕克斯——她在家族企业中和奶奶一起工作——说目前还不清楚是谁提名艾琳参选这个奖项的。

ex.s: My granddaughter has the same opinion as me.
He was sitting at the kitchen table, watching his ten-year-old granddaughter, Sophia, do her homework.
ex.t: 他坐在厨房的桌子旁，看着十岁的孙女索菲亚做作业。
